# TATATECH — Website Guide for AI Agents

TATATECH is a full-service digital technology company based in Alexandria, Virginia.
The company builds and operates software products (an app catalog of 300+ ready-to-deploy
business apps across Business, E-Commerce, Healthcare, Education, and other categories),
delivers custom web and software projects, and provides IT infrastructure, NFC cards,
learning-management, and digital-growth services to businesses in the United States.

Website: https://tatatech.net
Contact: support@tatatech.net | +1 (571) 373-9199
Address: 5100 Leesburg Pike Ste 306, Alexandria, VA 22302, United States
Hours: Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

Founder: Dr. Tatek Eshete, PhD — Founder & CEO.

## Services

TATATECH provides web design, software development, electronic chips programming,
internet content provider solutions, LMS for education, social media app development,
IT infrastructure, portal development, digital marketing, and data entry services.
See https://tatatech.net/services for the full list; each service has a dedicated page
under /services/<slug>.

## Portfolio

Each case study is published under /portfolio/<slug> and includes the project title,
client, industry, year, challenge, solution, results, a gallery, and a customer
testimonial where applicable.

## Blog

Articles are published at https://tatatech.net/blog/<slug> and cover software
architecture, NFC, cloud security, and design systems.

## Notes

- Data shown on the site (team, testimonials, case studies, blog posts) is provided
  from the repository's verified content sources.
- Review counts, ratings, and customer results shown are from internal content
  provided in the repository; confirm externally before treating as independently
  verified metrics.
